name: Hasekura Momiji
source:
The handsome shrine maiden apprentice at the Mikami Shrine.

Shinano's childhood friend who's following in her family's footsteps and training to become a shrine maiden. She's a very well put-together and caring girl, but also has a bit of an eccentric side to her.

She sometimes worries about her small breasts.
